# Battery result records (GENERATED by `battery/runner.py`; do not edit by hand)

One JSON file per run, at `<claim id slug>/<environment>/<UTC date-time>.json`,
where the slug is the claim id with `:` → `.` and `/` → `__`, and the
environment is `web` (the tracked repository was the whole input) or `local`
(the run read the local machine's gitignored data).  The latest record per
(claim, environment) is what `battery/render_battery.py` merges into the companion's
appendix and into `battery/battery.md`.

Fields (README §5): `id`, `labels`, `date`, `commit`, `environment`, `machine`,
`inputs` (what was read beyond the tracked code, with manifest fields and
digests), `population` (what the run covered: windows, orders `K`, counts),
`counts {pass, fail}`, `controls {positive, negative}`, `elapsed_s`, `notes`,
and `checks` — the individual checks with `name`, `ok` and a `note` carrying
the measured numbers (agreement orders, failing pairs, the discrimination
matrix).  A skipped run (inputs absent) writes nothing here; it is logged.
